items.title: Trading Costs and Machine-Learning Return Forecasts
items.claim: In U.S. stocks at $500 million, trading costs matter in portfolio construction, not the loss: spread-gated liquidity weighting lifts net Sharpe from -0.38 to 0.42.

items.title: Reading the News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
items.claim: Benchmarking news attention shocks against 63 trading days instead of 5 raises out-of-sample rank IC for every news reader tested.
